Best Time to Shop at Bin Stores in Brooklyn

Bin stores in Brooklyn follow different weekly schedules. However, most stores typically restock on Friday. On restock days, prices usually start around $12 per item. If you're after the deepest discount, the best time to visit is on Wednesday when items drop to just $1.

Pro tip: These schedules can change! We recommend following the Facebook pages of stores like Jumble for same-day inventory photos and restock announcements.

What to Expect at a Bin Store in Brooklyn

Bin stores in Brooklyn work differently from regular thrift stores. Instead of neatly shelved items, merchandise arrives in large open bins directly from Amazon return pallets and liquidation lots. Here's what first-timers should know:

  • Bring reusable bags — most bin stores don't provide shopping bags.
  • Arrive early on restock day (Friday) for the best selection.
  • Check electronics at the testing station (if available) before you buy.
  • Prices drop each day — the longer you wait, the lower the price.
  • Cash is preferred at some smaller locations, though most accept cards.
